set.body: Freeze evidence-sampling-v1 in executable laws before public calibration code. Cover relation versus relation_fit, endpoint versus edge independence, fixed versus learned metrics, equal versus heterogeneous partitions, calibration targets, local versus spatial covariance, and exact query-first materialization semantics. Acceptance: named identities and refusal rules are represented in canonical plan/receipt contracts and direct laws; no production interval claim is added.
set.title: Epic A: Freeze evidence-sampling semantics and capability gates
